text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh!!
Summer training camp is over already~?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! I wanted to spend
way, waay more time with Cheval-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"No... you two were pretty... really,
attached at the hip... the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I know I did ask for joint training, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
On our days off, she'd drag me around shopping...
and a few times, she even snuck under my futon...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm exhausted, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, becauseee~!
I wanted to be with Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Big sis just keeps smiling the whole time too,
and doesn't do a thing
to stop Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies.
It didn't look like you needed a lifeline.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Besides, if Cheval really hated it, she's the kind of girl who'd speak up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...Always so dishonest with your feelings.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, looks like the bus is here.
Shall we get on?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My sisters too...?
Aren't they going home in Dad's car like last year—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I decided to take the bus this year.
...I wanted to talk with you just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —The Queen Elizabeth II Cup?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Both Vivlos and I are planning to run.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And so, Cheval.
...Won't you run too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh... M-Me!?
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Distance-aptitude wise, it should suit you, shouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together, Cheval-chi~!
The "Three Sisters Showdown"!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that sound super fun!?
Aren't you excited!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No... thrilled isn't quite the word...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Well, there's also the Kyoto Daishoten and Japan Cup coming up, so I won't force you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: But you know. It's precisely because we trained together this summer—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In the same race.
If we go all out against each other, maybe there's even more we'll be able to see, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, please think about it. Be sure to talk to your Trainer about it, too."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Understood. I'll go consult with them—

With the three sisters aboard, the bus rolls on.
A turbulent autumn was about to begin.
